name: nodelane-act
description: Use Reddit and Zhihu through your signed-in browser with compact, on-demand MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Reddit and Zhihu tools for your browser session
interface.longDescription: Connect the NodeLane Act browser extension to read recommendations, search communities, paginate answers and comments, and perform supported interactions through your signed-in browser. Tools are discovered for the selected site and return compact results. User-requested writes execute directly. Requires the companion browser extension and Node.js 22 or later on the same computer; Windows is the currently verified platform.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recommendations from my signed-in Zhihu browser tab.
Find relevant Reddit discussions and summarize the top comments.
